text:
An optical shop with ophthalmologists to assist and advise.
If coming from Khuang Sing, don't take the first U-turn at the golf course as indicated by the map. Take the second U-turn after Krua Chalong restaurant, then keep to the left and you'll find the shop.

The shop is clean, has a warm atmosphere, and the staff are helpful. There's a wide selection of frames.

If you need new glasses, try visiting and using their services. You'll have a memorable experience.

restaurant_name: ร้านแว่นตาไดมอนด์อาย Diamond Eye Shop Chiang Mai
text:
The service was excellent. The staff were very helpful and extremely polite. The glasses I got are very comfortable to wear. Compared to ready-made lenses from regular stores, this is a huge difference. They offer many options, including screen light blocking and photochromic lenses, etc. Importantly, they have a huge selection of frames, both branded and generic, at affordable prices. Plus, getting a membership card for discounts on future frames is a bonus. I even got a Black Card, which gives me a 1,000฿ discount on frames – incredibly worthwhile! And the owner often holds giveaway events for customers. 🙏

P.S. The picture shows the glasses I got from the store after almost a year of use.
